Market today: Oil is the real driver, pushing higher on geopolitical tensions. This can spill over into tech, especially for names sensitive to supply chains or economic outlook.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate (-50.96%) given its leveraged nature and current status. SPAL is also a concern (-29.18%) for similar reasons. The rest are HOLDs.

Watch: Keep an eye on Intel (INTC) as it looks to boost prices, and Qualcomm (QCOM) with its AI infrastructure deal.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for catalysts in chip names.
plays: SOXL: TRIM - Consider reducing exposure given the significant loss and leveraged nature.
SPAL: TRIM - Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing this leveraged position.
